Actions.Text: AMEND (T) AND RECOMMIT TO GOVERNMENTAL OPERATIONS

Title: Authorizes remote electronic witnessing performed with an electronic notarization, facilitates recording of electronically executed conveyances, and validates electronic signatures on certain documents; repealer
Summary: Authorizes remote electronic witnessing performed in conjunction with an electronic notarization, facilitates recordation of electronically executed conveyances, and validates electronic signatures on powers of attorney.
LawCode: Rpld §305 subs 3 & 4, amd St Tech L, generally; rpld §7-103 sub§ (d), §12-103 sub§ (c), amd §12-102, UCC; amd §§290 & 291-i, RP L; amd §§5-1501 & 5-1504, Gen Ob L
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the state technology law, the uniform commercial code, the real property law and the general obligations law, in relation to authorizing remote electronic witnessing performed in conjunction with an electronic notarization, to facilitate recordation of electronically executed conveyances, and to validate electronic signatures on powers of attorney; and to repeal certain provisions of the state technology law and the uniform commercial code relating thereto
